non_growing_rule: Last up to 20 one-second samples: fitted conservative nonreclaimable slope <0.005 GiB/s; at least 4 samples. Includes other projects and process exit; stage high-water separately reported.
linear_convergence: Native positive KSP convergence reason with unchanged rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-24 and max_it 2000; exactly one linear system.
GPU_sampling: NVML v1 total-minus-free includes device reservation; prior nvidia-smi used metric excludes it. Compare free space or within-run deltas, not raw used across interfaces.
full_CFD_gate: All original gates including high-order output must pass independently. Known corrector failure currently blocks full CFD.
